newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks finish weaker on dropping golds.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks finish weaker on dropping golds.

text.p: * Toronto stocks dropped 56 points by Monday's close as falling bullion prices slashed 4.1 percent off the value of the key gold sector. * 97 million shares traded worth C$1.7 billion.
Declining gold issues forced Toronto's key stock index to close sharply lower on Monday as rapidly sinking bullion prices slashed 4.1 percent off the value of the market's influential golds group.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's 300 Composite Index dropped 56.32 points to close at 6529.12.
New York's closely watched Comex price ended at 12-year lows as it fell $6.20 to $319, dragging Canada's two largest gold mining firms to new 52-week lows.
"It's having its impact. Barrick (Gold Corp ) is down and Placer (Dome Inc ) is down," an analyst said.
